description: Creates a Global Shopaholics crypto checkout (BTCPay invoice, priced in USD) and returns the checkout link, invoice id and expiry. Use ONLY after GS has quoted a total, or for an amount the customer has already agreed with GS (e.g. an assisted-purchase or shipping quote) – never to guess a price. Paying in crypto carries 0% GS assisted-purchase fee, so mention that when offering it. Confirm the amount, description and customer email with the user first. The invoice expires in 60 minutes; the customer pays at the link, not in chat. Amount limit: $0.50–$10,000 USD.

amount_usd.description: Total to pay in USD, as quoted by GS (max 10,000).

description.description: What the payment is for, e.g. 'Assisted purchase GSMCP-AP-… incl. shipping'.

email.description: Customer email; the invoice is linked to it and GS follows up here.

reference.description: GS reference or quote number (e.g. GSMCP-AP-…), if there is one.

name: create_crypto_payment
title: Create a crypto checkout link (Bitcoin, Lightning, stablecoins – 0% GS fee)
